text:
Virginia State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Final Notice: Enforcement Penalties Begin on August 5.
Our records show that as of today, you still have an outstanding traffic ticket. In accordance with New Virginia State Administrative Code 15C-16.003, if you do not complete payment by August 4, we will take the following actions:
1. Report to the DMV violation database
2. Suspend your vehicle registration starting August 5.
3. Suspend driving privileges for 30 days
4. Transfer to a toll booth and charge a 35% service fee
5. You may be prosecuted and your credit score will be affected
Pay Now:
https://vvvvvvvvvvvvxinpay
Please pay immediately before enforcement to avoid license suspension and futher legal disputes.
(Reply Y and re-open this message to click the link, or copy it to your browser.)
notes: DMV-impersonation smishing text. The link is a placeholder drawn by the FTC (the number of 'v's is approximate). 'futher' is the scammer's spelling. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined.
